answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 141 identities means 141 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the mirror pair is tracked in the ripple ledger, the fable audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward demands answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 59%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
